TestLWTSchemaModification::test_index_dr.reason: Unique scenario (DROP/CREATE INDEX under LWT+read load) with real bug catches (scylladb/scylladb#11169, SCYLLADB-4784), but the load is mostly ineffective. Bug: `stop` Event is created once before the loop (lwt_schema_modification_test.py:532) and set after each loop (:555) but never cleared, so for loops>1 LWTLoad/ReadRows exit immediately; only the first loop runs concurrent load (since origin aa1f952f78). Bug: LWTLoad on rows 1001-9999 with prologue nrows=10000 (v=pk) never applies anything: INSERT IF NOT EXISTS hits existing rows, UPDATE IF v>50 AND v<1000 is false for v>=1001 (:138-152), so the 'LWT load' produces only non-applied Paxos rounds and no data/view changes; ReadRows reads a disjoint range (pk<1000) so its assert is trivially true. Runs only in gating jobs (next-dtest-tablets/consistent-topology, 32 runs, 100% pass); absent from dtest-release jobs.

TestLWTSchemaModification::test_material.reason: Scenario (MV build concurrent with LWT on base) not found in scylla tests, but the LWT load never changes data so no view updates are generated. Bug: LWTLoad on rows 1001-9999 with prologue nrows=10000 (v=pk) never applies anything: INSERT IF NOT EXISTS hits existing rows, UPDATE IF v>50 AND v<1000 is false for v>=1001 (:138-152), so the 'LWT load' produces only non-applied Paxos rounds and no data/view changes; ReadRows reads a disjoint range (pk<1000) so its assert is trivially true. Note: comment 'Create view ascending so top rows are untouched' (:412) is wrong - LIMIT 1000 is token-ordered by pk, so rows come from the whole range; only stable because LWTLoad is a no-op. Runs only in gating jobs (next-dtest-tablets/consistent-topology, 32 runs, 100% pass); absent from dtest-release jobs.
